description: Password managers, vaults and authenticators whose whole application is treated as a secure field on every driver (ADD-1, decided by the maintainer on 2026-11-11): hotstrings, keymap output, AI requests, clipboard borrowers and metrics stay inert there, whatever field has focus. `windows` lists process names (compared without case), `macos` application display names (exact), `linux` lowercase fragments of the application identity (the X11 WM class or Wayland app_id, /proc comm as fallback), matched as substrings so a reverse-DNS app_id such as org.keepassxc.KeePassXC is covered. Expand, never shrink. Read by _shared/apps/engine/secure_apps.lua (macOS, Linux); pinned by tools/test/test-secure-apps-single-source.cjs.
